text:
You need someone who can help your DTC brands turn TikTok and YouTube ads into sales, not just traffic, while working closely with your founder and adapting to each client’s needs.  

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboards, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m comfortable with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets, and I’m used to digging into performance data to find what’s actually driving results.  

In a recent Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I built a BigQuery and Looker Studio analysis that joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work led to 18% of ad budget being reallocated and customer acquisition cost dropping 12% the next quarter.  

I’d love to bring that same analytical, proactive approach to your pet enrichment account and help you scale with confidence.
